description: TEST KEYS ONLY. Every key here is a deterministic test key derived from a public label by the rule in keys.json; none is a secret, and none may be used outside tests.

derivation.rule: The private scalar d of each key is SHA-512 over the UTF-8 bytes of its label, read as a big-endian unsigned integer, reduced mod n, where n is the order of the key's curve. The public key is d times the curve generator.

seller.use: Signs quote tokens (the seller quote signer).
seller.label: fiat-x402-fixture-seller-v1

service.use: Signs payment tokens (the payment service). Its JWKS is served at {base URL}/.well-known/jwks.json.
service.label: fiat-x402-fixture-service-v1

buyer.use: Signs DPoP proofs (the buyer); payment tokens are bound to it by cnf.jkt.
buyer.label: fiat-x402-fixture-buyer-v1
